title: The First Vessel
answer: The First Vessel remembers innate power before modern bearers divided it into names. A rank-ten Darkness bearer may open the first covenant at an Arcane Crucible using Darkness three blocks outward and Pure Light on all four diagonals. The Vessel steals familiar power signatures, changes phase, sutures its arena and attempts ritual reconstitution. Interrupt its widening memory-circle before the old body is restored.
